name: Venice
rev_definition: Excludes Venice's subscription, API, and credit/DIEM revenue, which settle off-chain (card / Coinbase Commerce / Stripe-Bridge) with no on-chain footprint. Includes only the VVV buy-and-burn (= HoldersRevenue).
fees_definition: Excludes Venice's subscription, API, and credit/DIEM revenue, which settle off-chain (card / Coinbase Commerce / Stripe-Bridge) with no on-chain footprint. Includes only the on-chain VVV buy-and-burn (USD value of VVV burned), which equals HoldersRevenue.
holders_definition: USD value of VVV bought back and burned: programmatic per-subscription burns ($2 Pro / $5 Pro+ / $10 Max) plus discretionary revenue buybacks.
caveat: DefiLlama counts only the on-chain buy-and-burn; Venice's subscription and API revenue settles off-chain.
our_basis: {"window": "subscription and API-credit burns over the last 30 days \u00d7 365/30, plus the last three monthly buybacks \u00d7 12", "source": "Allium and our Base pull for burns; venicestats live price \u00d7 our circulating supply for market cap"}
peer_basis: {"window": "all on-chain burns over the last 90 days \u00d7 365/90", "source": "DefiLlama for burns; CoinGecko for market cap"}

name: Render
rev_definition: Includes 5% service fees paid to OTOY (company that created RENDER) and 95% of the fees that is burnt
fees_definition: Gross user-paid spend on render jobs under the Burn-Mint Equilibrium model (RNP-001). Each job is priced in USD; an equivalent USD value of RENDER is burned on the Solana SPL mint by the burn wallet. The on-chain burn represents the 95% node-operator side of gross job spend; gross fees are derived by dividing the burn value by 0.95. The remaining 5% Network Operator service fee is paid to OTOY off-chain per the Foundation's documented fee schedule and is not directly observed in the on-chain burn stream. Legacy Ethereum RNDR (pre-2023-11-02 Solana migration) is out of scope.
holders_definition: Includes 95% of the fees that is burnt
caveat: Job payments are burned, but node operators are paid in newly minted RENDER, so burns are not net of emissions.

name: Aethir
fees_definition: Service fees paid by developers to use aethir GPU services
caveat: Revenue is the 20% protocol fee on GPU rentals; DefiLlama records no holder revenue. Data arrive in weekly batches.

name: Virtuals
rev_definition: The part kept by the Virtuals treasury: all bonding-curve tax and launch fees of the original launch model, and its share of the agent-token trading tax (about 20% from December 2024 to March 2025, 30% since April 2025).
fees_definition: Fees paid to Virtuals Protocol: the 1% trading tax on agent tokens, plus the bonding-curve tax and agent launch fees of the original launch model. The agent-token tax is measured where it is paid out (Base and Robinhood tax managers, the Solana distributor) or where it accrues before being split (Arc tax vault, Ethereum tax wallet).
caveat: Revenue is the treasury's share of agent-token trading tax, not AI usage; no holder revenue recorded.

name: Akash
fees_definition: Lease fees paid by users to use Akash Network services.
caveat: Fees are compute lease payments; DefiLlama counts no burn or holder revenue, so only the fee multiple applies.

name: Livepeer
rev_definition: All the fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT tokens.
fees_definition: Fees paid by broadcasters for using the Livepeer protocol.
holders_definition: All the fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT tokens.
caveat: All fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT; paid in ETH.

name: Morpheus
fees_definition: Yield captured from deposits: stETH rebasing (Lido) + Aave V3 interest on wETH, USDC, USDT, wBTC.
holders_definition: MOR buybacks funded by yield (75%): buy & burn, buy & lock, buy & add to PoL.
caveat: Fees are yield on deposited capital, not AI usage; 75% buys MOR to burn, lock or add to liquidity.

name: Hyperliquid
caveat: Exchange; trading fees fund HYPE buybacks through the Assistance Fund.

name: Pump.fun
caveat: Launchpad; part of platform revenue buys back PUMP.

name: Aerodrome
caveat: DEX on Base; trading fees go to veAERO lockers who vote, not to every holder.
